speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset vertigo. To help me determine the cause, can you describe exactly what you are feeling right now?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with a sudden-onset sensation that the room is spinning, leading to several episodes of nausea and vomiting. The symptoms started as he was going to bed and lasted for approximately 3 minutes. He mentions that he has never experienced anything like this before and currently feels at his baseline.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV). The sudden onset lasting only 3 minutes, resolution to baseline, and lack of other neurological symptoms are classic for BPPV. Do you feel any hearing loss, tinnitus, or fullness in your ears?
